title: Held Crew Blocks and Failed-Access Visits — Installation Jobs
content:
**Held crew block and the failed-access visit basis — Installation Jobs**

The crew days held for an **Installation Jobs** record decide how the visit basis of a failed-access fee is worked out. The crew days held are the crew days booked for the job, or the crew days already worked if more — the crew days worked being the crew days recorded at the home on that job.

| Crew days held for the job | Visit basis |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the whole block is lost: the method's late reschedule fee multiplied by the crew days held |
| 2 | the method's failed-access fee plus the method's late reschedule fee |
| 1, or none | the method's failed-access fee |

Both fee figures are those of the job's installation method.

## Worked examples (hypothetical fee figures: failed-access 225.00, late reschedule 175.00)

| Crew days booked | Crew days already worked | Crew days held | Visit basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1 | 4 | 175.00 times 4, that is 700.00 |
| 2 | 3 | 3 | 175.00 times 3, that is 525.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 225.00 plus 175.00, that is 400.00 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 225.00 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 225.00 |
